note: Offline-verifiable host and endpoint evidence for official state sources, migrated from the S7-P1-48 public-page observations (2026-11-03). Metadata only: no page text. A record is either a host-level observation (shows the host is the publisher's) or a source_class observation (shows a specific endpoint serves the listed source classes). The registry approves nothing by itself: approvals live in state_sources.json and must cite records here by evidence_id. Public access is not reuse permission; nothing here grants any right.

validity_policy.reference: for a manifest entry, its asset.retrieved_at; for contract checks, an explicit reference date
validity_policy.requested_url: https, or http/https with a redirect chain that ends at final_url
validity_policy.source_class_approval_requires: a source_class-level record on the same host whose source_classes include the class
validity_policy.host_approval_requires: a host- or source_class-level record on the same host
